항목.프롬프트: Draw the next upgrade level of this exact sheepfold in the same style, colors and camera angle: a larger round fold with taller dressed-stone walls, a sturdier wooden gate facing the viewer, a reed-roofed stone hut with a small window, a water trough, four woolly sheep inside and a shepherd's sling hanging on the gatepost.

Draw the highest upgrade level of this exact sheepfold in the same style, colors and camera angle: a strong fortified fold of cut limestone with a timber watch platform over the gate, a red and gold banner, a stone hut with a tiled roof, bronze-studded gate facing the viewer, sheep inside, a lion skin draped over the wall as a trophy.

Draw the next upgrade level of this exact work yard in the same style, colors and camera angle: a bigger stone-throwing machine with a reinforced timber frame and rope windlass, a stone-paved floor, a builder's crane, stacked cut stones and a craftsman in a leather apron operating it.

Draw the highest upgrade level of this exact work yard in the same style, colors and camera angle: a masterwork stone-throwing machine of polished acacia wood with gold and bronze fittings and carved decorations, on a stone platform, with a master craftsman in a blue tunic and leather apron, finely cut stones and gleaming tools around.
